work_info.title: What is Photo Manipulation?
descriptions: Photo Manipulation is a creative editing process that transforms standard images into unique, high-impact visuals for branding, advertising, and digital campaigns. It combines multiple elements, effects, and artistic techniques to create compelling visual storytelling.

list.content: Composite Image Creation: Merging multiple images seamlessly into one cohesive visual.
Creative Background & Scene Design: Building imaginative or conceptual environments.
Lighting & Color Harmony: Matching tones and shadows across combined elements.
Detail Blending & Refinement: Ensuring realistic edges, textures, and transitions.
Campaign-Ready Visual Output: Crafting striking images for ads, social media, and branding.
